summary: fractal-web adopts the fractal-ui follow set: a floating Scroll to end pill that hides on press intent and eases back to the growing transcript end (instant under prefers-reduced-motion), reader input cancels the return, and detached history keeps its anchor while content grows or shrinks above it. Bounded turns anchor their nested rows (tool status, thinking entries, work-log summaries) instead of the turn wrapper, and switching back to a conversation inside the app restores the reader's row by its item id. Sidebar rows omit attention and unread signals the runtime does not report.

compatibility.detail: Only packages/fractal-ui changes. The restored row lives in memory for the page lifetime; no storage, protocol or wire-format change.

recovery.detail: No database or runtime recovery change.
